summary: You feel in bursts, and you need room to feel them. Your emotions and your need for freedom are fused, so closeness and independence pull at you at the same time. You bond, then you need air.
body: You feel in bursts, and you need room to feel them. Your emotions and your need for freedom are fused, so closeness and independence pull at you at the same time. You bond, then you need air. This can feel like emotional steadiness is hard to trust, so detachment becomes a way to stay safe. As an adult you may keep things light, or get drawn to people who can't fully show up. The work is letting someone close without feeling trapped. Freedom and attachment can share the same house.
gift: At your best: emotionally honest, adaptable, free without going cold.
shadow: The trap: detaching to feel safe, or choosing people who can't fully show up.
integration: Let emotional needs and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for inventive moves and breaking stale routines; poor for steady, predictable handling.
do: Let someone close without feeling trapped
Ask for space instead of vanishing
Notice if you keep picking the unavailable
dont: Keep it light to avoid the depth
Confuse needing air with needing out
